plugin.name: Action Deck
plugin.description: Bind items, spells, attacks and chat macros to a movable bar with up to 48 slots.

plugin.name: Auto Craft
plugin.description: Find recipes and craft a chosen quantity with ingredients from your packs.

plugin.description: Show a plate with name, level, health and debuffs on chosen bosses, with optional chat alerts and minimap markers.

plugin.description: Hide chat lines by category and play an alert when chat contains chosen text.

plugin.description: Explore local PNG artwork, native effects and layered gauges in a small companion plugin.

plugin.description: Pin a counter for selected items across your packs.

plugin.name: Third Eye
plugin.description: Watch nearby spawns by name, mark matches and receive chat or sound alerts.

plugin.description: Automate combat, recovery, buffs, crafting, fellowship, routes and looting.

plugin.name: UCM Micro
plugin.description: Run combat and recovery from a compact panel, or control the full UCM profile when installed and enabled.
